_READ_ME: THIS IS ONLY AN EXAMPLE OF THE INJECTION CONTRACT — do not run it as-is.
In ComfyUI open YOUR working graph (qwen_image_edit_fp8_e4m3fn + qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled
text encoder + qwen_image_vae + Qwen-Image-Edit-Lightning-4steps LoRA), then:
Workflow menu -> Export -> 'Save (API Format)' -> save over comfyui/workflow.json
comfyui.promptNodeId    = id of the node whose text widget receives the art prompt
comfyui.baseImageNodeId = id of the LoadImage node that should receive the deterministic
base layout PNG (the factory uploads it automatically).
Use "" if your graph generates from scratch instead.
The factory injects plan.art_prompt (which always reserves the top-left logo zone and
keeps the TikTok/Shorts safe zones calm) and queues /prompt, polls /history, pulls /view.
